sections.title: What is a Meaning?
sections.content: A meaning provides a definition or explanation of what a lemma represents. A lemma can have multiple meanings, each in a different language (typically English or Hindi). Meanings are displayed to learners and help them understand the word.

items.meaning: To run; to move quickly on foot
दौड़ना; पैरों पर तेज़ी से चलना

items.example: Using technical jargon that learners won't understand
items.solution: Write simple, clear definitions appropriate for the target audience's language level.

items.mistake: Including the lemma word in its own meaning
items.example: For 'धावणे' (to run), writing 'धावणे means to run fast'
items.solution: Define the concept, not the word itself. Write 'To run; to move quickly on foot' instead.

items.mistake: Setting same priority for all meanings
items.example: Giving priority 1 to both primary and secondary meanings
items.solution: Use priority to order meanings by importance. Primary meaning should be 1, secondary 2, etc.
